integrity: Original published periodic orbits and graph dynamics are explicitly credited; new argument concerns global planar exceptional-set geometry. Exact arithmetic checker corroborates explicit orbit and arithmetic identities but is not a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: For irrational parameters and reduced rational denominators prime to neither necessarily 3 nor 5 but not divisible by 15, the planar basin is full-measure and the complement has dimension one. Reduced rational denominators divisible by 15 are not classified; original graph-capture and graph-dynamics premises are cited rather than reproved. No uniform first-entry-time bound is asserted.
title: Global finite-time seven-cycle capture outside a one-dimensional exceptional set
